notes.title: "NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD: Typing of The Net" is now unveiled!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is WSS Playground.

We are excited to announce "NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD: Typing of The Net"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3215170

This is a typing game where you input internet slang in a call-and-response style with Super Ten-chan.

The game is scheduled for release on January 21, 2025. Please add it to your wishlist!

In addition, the Steam-exclusive deluxe edition, "NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD Internet Angel Pack," is also in production!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39076964/5bfab5eaea54eb512175f62926b7665ab888d4bf.png[/img]

The deluxe edition includes:

・The NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD base game
・NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD ARTWORKS (newly created)
　※ Over 300 pages of game design materials and illustrations.
・NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD Soundtrack vol.1
・NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD Soundtrack vol.2 (newly created)
　※ Features tracks like "INTERNET YAMERO," "月虹蝶," and "きゅびずむ," plus BGM from spin-off games.
・NEEDY STREAMER OVERLOAD: Typing of The Net (newly created)
　※ A typing game where you input internet slang with Super Ten-chan.
・Petit Game Collection vol.1

This bundle is packed with amazing content and is set to release on January 21, 2025.

Both upcoming physical editions include a copy of the game for Nintendo Switch in addition to a variety of high-quality collectibles.

-	Full-size Happi Coat
-	K-Angel Chibi Plushie
-	Phone Standee

notes.title: NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE Announcement of Postponement of Release
notes.content:
We would like to officially announce that in order to focus on providing players with the highest-quality game possible, the release of NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE – originally scheduled for Steam release on June 5th, 2021 – has been postponed.

The final release date will be announced upon confirmation.
We want to offer our sincerest apologies to all of the players who have been waiting patiently for this release, and we appreciate your understanding and support as we further increase our efforts to provide you with the best and most appropriate “play” possible.

[h3]NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE Overview[/h3]

NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE is a “multi-ending ADV” depicting daily life with “OMGkawaiiAngel-chan”, a young girl with a rather extreme need for approval attempting to become the #1 “Internet Angel” (streamer). Gradually build up OMGkawaiiAngel-chan’s number of followers as she spends her days streaming, using various medications, and generally being kinda messed up. Experience all the different crazy ups and downs and find out for yourself whether this story is even capable of having a happy ending.
